title: Oxygen — Crew Mask Regulator — Install the Sleeved Supply Hose and the Stowage Guide Bracket
abstract: Replaces the crew mask supply hose with a sleeved variant and installs a guide bracket that holds the stowed hose clear of the sliding table runner, following abrasion findings at the five year inspection.

sections.planning_reason: Scheduled inspection found abrasion on the outer cover of eleven crew mask hoses across nine aircraft, all on the first officer side at the same station where the stowed hose lies against the sliding table runner. None had reached the pressure carrier, but the wear rate implies a through-cover finding well before the next inspection on high utilisation aircraft. The crew mask must be donnable in seconds, so a degraded hose is not acceptable between inspections.
sections.description: This bulletin replaces the supply hose with a variant of the same length carrying a woven abrasion sleeve, installs a guide bracket on the existing console side panel attachments and replaces the obsolete manifold at the regulator outlet, whose outlet angle is what forces the hose against the runner. The mask, the stowage box and the regulator are unchanged.
sections.accomplishment_summary: Close the crew oxygen supply and depressurise the line at the regulator, then apply the warning notices. Remove the console side panel, disconnect and remove the supply hose and the obsolete manifold. Install the new manifold and torque as specified, then install the guide bracket on the existing attachments. Fit the sleeved hose, dressing the sleeved section into the stowage so that it lies on the guide and not on the runner. Pressurise, do a leak check at the regulator and mask connections, and do the crew oxygen system test in AMM-M-35-10-12-000-038-A. Refit the console side panel, check the mask donning time and make the records entry.
sections.effectivity_note: Applies to all MERIDIAN-42 and MERIDIAN-46 aircraft delivered before MSN M00231. Both flight crew stations must be embodied at the same visit; a mixed standard across the two stations is not permitted because the stowage dressing differs.
sections.material_note: Kit contains two sleeved hoses, two guide brackets and two manifolds, with the fastener set. The removed manifolds are quarantined and returned; the removed hoses are scrapped locally after the pressure carrier has been examined and the result recorded on the reply form.

type_data.compliance_time: Within 18 months of the date of this Service Bulletin, or at the next crew oxygen system inspection, whichever occurs first.
